examples.caption: Kapsalon
examples.body: Kapsalon is a Dutch takeaway dish with fries, chicken or shawarma meat, melted cheese, lettuce, garlic sauce and sambal. What is the best way to prepare it at home so the fries stay crisp?

examples.caption: Kapsalon
examples.body: In deze kapsalon kun je je haar laten knippen, wassen en verven. Welke kapper heeft ervaring met krullend haar en hoe maak ik een afspraak voor een nieuw kapsel?

examples.caption: Red panda
examples.body: Red pandas are small reddish mammals with striped tails living in Himalayan forests. Habitat loss threatens them. How can conservation protect wild red pandas in Nepal and preserve their bamboo habitat?

examples.caption: Giant panda
examples.body: Giant pandas are black and white bears from mountain bamboo forests in China. Conservation and habitat protection help wild pandas survive. Why is bamboo so important for a giant panda's diet?

examples.caption: Koalas
examples.body: Koalas are Australian marsupials living in eucalyptus trees. They eat eucalyptus leaves and carry their young in a pouch. How can we protect koala habitats from deforestation and bushfires?

examples.caption: Animals
examples.body: Animals include mammals, birds, reptiles, fish and insects. Different species have different diets and habitats. What can people do to protect endangered wildlife and preserve biodiversity around the world?

examples.caption: Nintendo Switch
examples.body: Nintendo Switch is Nintendo's hybrid video game console. The family includes the original model, the OLED model and Nintendo Switch 2. What are their differences in hardware, games, controls and repairability?

examples.caption: Nintendo Switch 2
examples.body: Nintendo Switch 2 is the successor to Nintendo's original hybrid game console. What changes did Nintendo make to its hardware, display, Joy-Con controllers and internal components, and how easy is it to repair?

examples.caption: Nintendo Switch OLED
examples.body: Nintendo Switch OLED is a version of the original hybrid console with an OLED screen and redesigned dock. What changed inside the OLED model and how easy are the screen and battery to replace?

examples.caption: Steam Deck
examples.body: Valve Steam Deck is a handheld gaming PC. The family includes LCD and OLED models running SteamOS and playing PC games. How do the different versions compare in hardware, battery life and repairability?

examples.caption: Steam Deck OLED
examples.body: Valve Steam Deck OLED is the revised handheld gaming PC with an OLED screen, improved battery life and revised internal components. How easy is it to repair the OLED version and replace its display or battery?

examples.caption: Steam Deck LCD
examples.body: Valve Steam Deck LCD is the original handheld gaming PC with an LCD screen. How can its battery, fan, thumbsticks and display be replaced, and what should owners know before opening this original model?

examples.caption: Games
examples.body: Video games can be played on personal computers, consoles and handheld devices. Players choose from strategy, role playing, action and multiplayer games. Which gaming platforms and genres are people enjoying?
